canonical_campaign_exclusion_reason: One llama-completion process with a 64-token ceiling proves bounded Android viability only; it is not the protocol-v2 loaded-route 1+5+5+5 campaign.

generation.actual_output_tokens_method: llama-completion n_predict=64 reached with 63 follow-on eval runs and no EOG stop; CLI appends one terminal newline outside generated token bytes.

limitations: Warm starting conditions were retained rather than hidden: thermal status 2, AP 47.6 C, skin 41.4 C.
This one-request 64-token smoke cannot populate the Android benchmark registry or support canonical campaign distributions.
No protocol TTFT or setup boundary is available from llama-completion.

memory.method: Approximately 100-260 ms shell sampling of /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup and /proc/<pid>/status over the llama-completion process lifecycle.

operating_context.power_measurement_null_reason: No external or authoritative device power meter was available; USB powered state and battery dumps are retained.

timing.post_prefill_to_first_token_null_reason: No alignable first-token delivery timestamp is exposed.
timing.request_to_first_token_null_reason: The non-streaming completion executable does not expose a caller-observed first generated token-ID timestamp.
timing.runtime_decode_definition: llama.cpp eval time covers 63 follow-on model evaluations after the first sampled token; it is retained as runtime internal timing, not relabeled as protocol decode delivery timing.
timing.setup_seconds_null_reason: llama-completion does not expose a readiness boundary separate from its single request; runtime-reported load time overlaps prompt evaluation and is retained without relabeling it as setup.
